title: Precompiled rendering: definitions once, direct slot mutation thereafter
summary: Wire UI avoids routine component-tree reconciliation by separating generic renderer primitives, immutable site definitions and live instance/slot state. Definitions are installed/prepared once; live queue traffic addresses exact instances and slots.
invariants: Routine rendering does not rebuild a component tree merely to discover what changed.
Definitions are immutable/versioned and may be content-addressed and cached.
The hot render path must not branch on browser brand or repeatedly interpret semantic definitions.
Generic renderer primitives may be specialised for a negotiated capability/display profile before live rendering.
Persistent browser storage may contain immutable definitions/runtime assets but not authoritative live session state.
procedure: Receive or recover the exact definition from immutable cache.
Compile it once to concrete element factories and direct slot writers for the selected render profile.

provenance.claim: Definitions are prepared once, routine rendering is direct slot mutation, and cache holds only immutable definitions.
One-time render profile negotiation and content-addressed definition cache.
